normative_extracts.quote: Capture all changes to an application state as a sequence of events, allowing current state to be rebuilt deterministically by replaying the log.
Changes are made with pure functions that take the previous state and an action and return the next state without side effects.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Derives UI state as a deterministic fold over an append-only log of serializable commands, enabling exact replay and O(1) scrubbing with checkpoints.

production_failures.symptom: Tab crashes with Out-Of-Memory during long Figma-like canvas sessions
production_failures.root_cause: Every pointermove event appended a full command and deep state snapshot to an unbounded array.
production_failures.mitigation: Coalesce high-frequency drag commands on pointerup and compact older logs into periodic structural-sharing checkpoints.

production_failures.symptom: Replaying a user's exported bug log produces different IDs and timestamps
production_failures.root_cause: Reducer called Date.now() and crypto.randomUUID() during execution instead of reading pre-generated values from the command payload.
production_failures.mitigation: Move all non-deterministic inputs into the command creator before appending to the log.
